All files have "disposable" status, which means they are not protected. So I can delete them to free up space.

If I delete all of them: 46 + 15 + 13 + 11 + 8 = 93 GB freed, which is more than the required 42 GB.

- All except chunk_gc.dat: 46 + 15 + 13 + 11 = 85 GB (meets requirement)

The most straightforward approach is to delete just chunk_7f3a.dat which gives us 46 GB, exceeding the 42 GB requirement.
